name: mathmodeling-skills
description: A gated mathematical-modeling contest workflow with human-owned modeling decisions, reproducible experiments, and submission audits.

interface.longDescription: Frame contest problems, screen methods, run reproducible experiments, freeze verified results, draft evidence-backed paper sections, and audit the final submission while keeping modeling judgments with the human modeler.
defaultPrompt: Frame this modeling problem and route the next workflow gate.
Audit this modeling workspace and identify the next action.
Prepare this verified model for submission without inventing claims.
